text: Oakmere Credit Union just got its regulatory exam results back, and the SOC didn't come out clean.
Three findings: weak detection coverage, no formal incident-response process, and legacy service accounts bypassing MFA with no documented control.
As SOC Analyst Renata Ibarra, your first job isn't writing a fix -- it's sitting down with Security, Compliance, and IT to get the exact finding language.
The tenant is oakmere-cu, the Sentinel workspace is law-oakmere-soc, and right now most of what's running there is an unmodified default.
Next: turning these three findings into a scoped project -- detection, identity, and a zero-trust pilot.
